title: Infection Control Nurse
description: Job Title: Infection Control Nurse Company Name: Manipal Hospitals Job Description: The Infection Control Nurse will be responsible for overseeing the hospital's infection control program. This includes developing, implementing, and monitoring infection prevention and control practices to ensure patient and staff safety. The nurse will conduct regular audits and surveillance of infection control practices within the hospital, educate staff and patients on infection prevention strategies, and collaborate with healthcare teams to improve outcomes. The role requires participation in quality improvement initiatives and adherence to regulatory guidelines for infection control. Key Responsibilities: - Assess and identify potential areas of infection risk within the hospital setting. - Develop and implement policies and procedures related to infection prevention and control. - Monitor infection rates and analyze data to identify trends. - Provide training and education to healthcare staff about infection control practices and protocols. - Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop strategies to reduce infection rates. - Participate in infection control committees and support accreditation efforts. - Respond to infection control inquiries and provide guidance as needed. - Review and update infection control manuals and resources regularly. Skills and Tools Required: - Strong knowledge of infection prevention and control principles. - Effective communication and interpersonal skills to educate staff and patients. - Analytical skills for data collection and trend analysis. - Familiarity with regulatory standards and guidelines related to infection control. - Proficiency in electronic health record (EHR) systems and other healthcare software. - Certification in Infection Control (CIC) is preferred. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. - Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. - Knowledge of clinical practices and procedures related to infection control in healthcare settings. This position plays a crucial role in maintaining a safe healthcare environment and ensuring adherence to best practices in infection control. Candidates should have a passion for patient safety and a commitment to quality healthcare.
